evidenceClassification.A: Current authoritative source or existing owned-input fact; not proof that receiver-v2 has formal ownership.
evidenceClassification.B: Deterministic consistency/projection from available facts; an isolated design packet is not formal Match or Save admission.
evidenceClassification.C: Unavailable authoritative source or integration; block the affected receiver-v2 surface instead of inventing values.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: The owner explicitly selects fields and clones contextSnapshot; unknown top-level request fields are dropped.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Common physical handoff must own a version pin before any execution. Meaningful contextSnapshot may carry a validated consistency copy; routine must use the same common owner without creating a situation.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Existing admission records playerDecision/automaticResolution/aiDecision ownership and route count, not receiver execution version.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Keep player decision admission separate from receiver model admission. New SS-primary empty-base policy must pin before first execution, including hold/offline/no-delivery branches; never choose by outcome.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: executionState is replaced by status/selectedRoute/handoffRef/physicalConsequenceApplied/executionIdentity. Additive pin/binding fields would be lost.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Explicitly retain only validated receiver admission reference and binding locations. Compare common handoff to meaningful context copy before this replacement; do not pull current policy on recovery.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Current family execution cache is checked against resolution, then resolveSituation copies executionEvidence and spreads the existing executionState with complete status.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: A future version-aware validator must compare frozen actors/capabilities/sample/timing against authoritative cache before preserving a receiver binding copy. A shadow diagnostic must stay outside executionEvidence.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: The existing settlement identity is marked applied once and settled/closed duplicates return unchanged; it neither selects nor validates a receiver model.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Keep actual settlement authority and exactly-once identity. Persist only validated version references if future runtime needs them; do not infer v2 from settled statistics or backfill legacy.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Close requires resolution, applied settlement and no pending execution/reassessment. Summary explicitly emits a limited field set and omits receiver version/binding.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Future summary retention needs an explicit reference-only design; a summary cannot reconstruct receiver output or justify re-recording a settled play.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Outer lifecycle version and state are checked, then the saved object is cloned/frozen. Arbitrary additive fields can survive structurally but receive no receiver-v2 semantic validation.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Retaining a field is not validating a pin. A format-aware receiver guard must run before normalization can be treated as v2 admission.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Existing normalizeHandoff deep-clones and freezes any object; it does not choose a receiver version, validate source provenance or reconcile receiver copies.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Keep the common physical handoff as proposed sole pin authority. Validate raw format and cross-owner copies before accepting receiver-v2 fields; clone/freeze remains legacy-preserving.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: sourceSaveVersion is captured at entry; fresh defaults and Object.assign precede downstream handoff/lifecycle normalization, and saveVersion is overwritten with current SAVE_VERSION near return.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Inspect raw saved format/model discriminators at function entry, before defaults/normalization or version rewriting. Future-version missing/malformed tags cannot masquerade as historical saves; optional tag absence alone cannot authenticate history.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Pending reach validation uses actual defense roster, then shared decision-throw validation runs. The shared function returns early for firstBase, thirdBase, missing decision facts and settlementApplied.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Run a common receiver format/pin/copy guard before every family/settled early return, preserving current family validators. Unknown or contradictory new versions must reject before live player/cursor/record mutation.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: SS historical saves may omit additive actionFacts/executionSample; present copies must equal reconstructed owner facts. Legacy 2B stages retain their admission when no new action contract is present.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Keep these legacy rules exact. A future required-format receiver pin cannot use the legacy omission exceptions. Do not globally require new additive copies for genuinely historical saves.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Recovery requires matching physical identity, situation, original outs/bases/score and settlement identity, rejects already-applied handoff state, validates stored resolution, then uses the existing routine/meaningful apply path.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: A future receiver pin guard must precede cache delivery and preserve original execution version. Recovery must not execute a candidate diagnostic or reinterpret a pinned play through current policy.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: createPin freezes a beforeExecution policy/request and keeps official execution owner legacy; retainPin is metadata-only across pending/executed/settled and never reselects.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Use this as contract review input. Formal owner must verify phase/handoff/roster/source authority and preserve fields; importing this module alone is not lifecycle integration.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Only isolated pending serialization can return ok with formalSaveAdmission=false. Candidate executed/settled explicitly return insufficient candidateRuntimeSaveNotImplemented.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Formal v2 Save admission needs raw discriminator, sealed execution binding, every present copy, actual owner inputs and cold/duplicate tests. Never relabel insufficient branches as Save PASS.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Requires a separate known-history/source-version/provenance claim and rejects present new discriminators. It is a routing contract, not normalizeSave or authentication.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Existing Save owner must supply independently validated format/history evidence. Removing all tags plus forging old format cannot be identified by a digest or this isolated API alone.

lifecycleRows.currentFact: Current owner strictly recomputes v1 resolveTiming and rejects stale timing; it then owns force semantics, legal receiver touch/tag, runner results and completeSettlement/third-out projection.
lifecycleRows.draftChange: Define a version-aware validation seam in this existing owner before v2 can affect an outcome. Legacy v1 remains exact; v2 CRT must validate common origin/possession/contact/live force/ordered third-out. No new settlement or apply owner.

proposedFieldMap.authoritativeAdmission: groundBallInPlayState.receiverModelAdmission, chosen by the existing physical-play/admission owner before first execution
proposedFieldMap.meaningfulConsistencyCopy: activeSituation.contextSnapshot.receiverModelAdmission; compare to common handoff, never independently select
proposedFieldMap.routineRule: Common handoff only; no invented player-decision situation
proposedFieldMap.executionBinding: Existing family execution cache receiverModelExecutionBinding (draft); carry a validated reference through lifecycle executionState explicitly
proposedFieldMap.sampleRule: Original owned sample is bound only at its existing first execution callback; pending admission must not pre-draw, recovery and duplicate must not call RNG
proposedFieldMap.diagnosticStorage: Separate read-only sidecar/design artifact, outside official executionEvidence, simulationLog, completedMoments, GameRecord, MatchExperience and Save; no storage implementation in this sprint
proposedFieldMap.settledReference: Deliberate version/binding references only if needed by future pinned resolver; never backfill legacy statistics

formalGuardOrder: 1. Raw saved format/model discriminator and trusted-history policy before normalizeSave defaults/clone/version upgrade.
2. Current physical handoff/roster/runner/route/version/phase checks before beginning any new execution.
3. Common receiver version/pin/copy validation at shared decision-throw entry before firstBase/3B/settlementApplied early returns.
4. Validate original cache/execution binding before recovery, record or existing one-time apply.
5. Existing settlement/Force/Third-Out and record/development owners remain sole official consumers; diagnostic packets are excluded.

timingSeam.legacyPath: Keep exact v1 resolveTiming equality and all legal force/third-out behavior.
timingSeam.receiverV2Path: New explicit model/timing discriminator selecting a validator for already-owned frozen delivery and CRT stage facts; reject unknown versions, contradictory origin, missing possession or contact.
timingSeam.insufficientSourceBehavior: BLOCK affected v2 route. Do not convert ordinal windows to CRT, synthesize missing movement/touch facts, run new success rolls or create retirement from an unapplied pure candidate.

gameRecord.fact: recordEvent dispatches PA/run/defensive events and maintains event IDs; recordDefensivePlay additionally deduplicates actor stats by defensivePlayIdentity. Candidate diagnostics must never become one of those official event types.

evaluation.fact: deriveMatchExperienceEvidence consumes simulationLog playerRoutinePlay and completedMoments defense/offense, or supplied activeEvidence. settleMatchExperienceDevelopment applies derived contexts once per settled match. A candidate stage/possible E/out must not be supplied as actual activeEvidence or a completed moment.

officialDiagnosticBoundaries.scorer: No new scorer owner, E/A accumulator or official PA path. Ordinary effort/clean-correction/extra-advance authority gaps remain C; no automatic E, would-be A or H suppression.

preservationRules: Historical pending uses original legacy authority; no v2 sampling or stages.
Historical executed validates present existing copies and delivers original cache; no reroll.
Historical settled retains original record/reference; no backfill, replay apply or re-record.
Policy changes affect only unadmitted new opportunities; a pinned pending/executed/settled opportunity cannot upgrade/downgrade.
Required new-format field removal is invalid rather than historical omission. Fully stripped/forged format needs authoritative external history/format evidence; no digest authentication claim.

verification.method: Bounded source/graph comparison only; formal lifecycle and Save statuses derive from current source limits, not newly executed acceptance tests.
